reason: We stick to free stuff like storytime, parks and church groups, and we'd maybe go once or twice a month. That doesn't come close to justifying $59 a month.
objection: Two visits a month at $12 each is already $24, and a membership only makes sense if I'd go 5+ times. I don't pay for kid activities much, and I work remotely, so my free days are limited.
would_change_my_mind: A flat pay-as-you-go option with no monthly commitment, like a 10-visit pass around $60 that doesn't expire, or a free trial visit that proved my kid loved it.
